text:
Altcoins in a bear market aren't cheap just because they're down 80%.

Down 80% can always become down 95%. Down 95% can become down 99% etc.

Valuation only matters when the market decides it does.

And the one thing that has been very clear is that FDV (Fully Diluted Valuation) is the price you really pay.

Plenty of big VC coins are down over 95% price wise from their highs but might "only" be down about 50% in their market cap based on circulating supply.

Token unlocks and inflation are your biggest enemy when bullish momentum and buyers dry up. They will make the difference between alts being down -80% or -99% by the end of a bear market.
